Application reference

Need help?

01 / Your business and contact

Choose Dealer or Distributor, then provide your legal business and contact details. Required fields are marked *.

Business EIN only: 9 digits, with or without a hyphen (XX-XXXXXXX). Do not enter a Social Security number or a personal tax ID.

02 / Your customers and territory

Supplying only your own stores is a retail account. Distribution means supplying other independent retail businesses.

Sales channels *
Products you want to carry *

03 / Your purchasing plan

These estimates help our team discuss account fit. This form does not set pricing, opening minimums, credit terms or approval thresholds.

04 / Your operating capacity

Tell us what is ready and what is still in development. Enter a business EIN only in the EIN field. Do not enter Social Security numbers, personal tax IDs, bank details, card numbers or identity documents.

Directory participation is optional. If your application is approved, MT E.L.K., INC. will notify you about the next steps. If you choose to participate, we will confirm your business listing details with you before publishing.

05 / Review, authorize and send

Review every answer, then authorize the application. Submission does not approve an account, offer credit, or reserve an exclusive territory.

Your typed name, saved date/time, time zone and browser/device details will be included in the application record, PDF and prepared email. Confirm again if you change an answer.

Signature and saved timestamp

Email a completed application

Download your PDF and prepare a message from your own email app. You attach the PDF and press Send. This is separate from submitting through the website.

Your completed PDF and email details include your business information and EIN, if provided. Keep them private and check the recipients before sending.

Printing or downloading a PDF does not submit an application. Submit through the website, or prepare an email, attach the PDF and send it from your email app.

When you submit through this website, Netlify stores your application details and shares them with MT E.L.K., INC. for business review and follow-up. Downloading a PDF or preparing an email does not send the application. Answers are not saved as a browser draft. No marketing subscription is required.
